messages:
Alex (arch): Heads-up — starting a long-term roadmap thread for routing policy + multi-region tenant isolation. Need to align launch gates, customer asks, and the migration playbook. Proposed milestones below — can folks comment by EOD Thu?

Maya (product): +1. Please include policy-as-code templates so tenant ops can self-serve configuration. Also add a data-residency parity checklist (hosted vs private).

Jamal (eng-runtime): From runtime POV: KV cache consistency across regions and tail latency on cross-region fallback are the biggest constraints. We need clear SLOs to make engineering trade-offs.

Sophie (pm): Draft launch criteria suggestion: availability >= 99.9% per region, p95 end-to-end latency <= 200ms for edge-pref routes, automated canary + rollback, and migration should be zero-downtime for live traffic. Require audit logs + KMS support for GA.

Oliver (sales): FYI — EU bank asked for strict data residency + per-tenant KMS + audit trail. That will push Private deployment requirements earlier.

Alex (arch): Proposed phased rollout: 1) policy-as-code alpha + templates + telemetry; 2) regional affinity + soft-fallback and migration playbook; 3) hard isolation lanes + tenant quarantine + contractual SLAs. Timeline: Q3 (alpha) -> Q4 (pilot) -> Q1 next year (GA).

Jamal (eng-runtime): Tech gaps to resolve: cross-region KV-sync RFC, affinity scoring heuristic (latency + cost), routing policy evaluation harness (offline sim), and a cost model for extra replicas. We'll need estimated CPU/GPU delta per 1000 RPS.

Maya (product): Prioritization note: shipping templates + telemetry first is low effort, high impact for sales and onboarding speed. Suggest gating metric: reduce tenant onboarding time by 30% vs today.

Sophie (pm): Recommend customer pilot cohort: 1 strategic customer (EU bank) for residency & audit, 2 mid-market (US SaaS) for scale and migration runbook validation.

Oliver (sales): :thumbsup: I can coordinate the pilot commitments and NDAs.

Alex (arch): Negotiation question: what SLA level do we commit at GA (dedicated capacity customers vs hosted fallback)? Need input from legal/sales on exposure.

Jamal (eng-runtime): Implementation note: feature-flags + policy validation required. Example policy yaml for affinity control: 
```
policy: tenant_affinity
rules:
  - region_preference: eu-west-1
  - max_latency_ms: 250
```
This will be validated at admission time and enforced by the router.

infra-bot: deploy scheduled: policy-rfc-branch -> staging at 4312345800 by Jamal

Sophie (pm): Next steps: Alex to consolidate RFC with phases & launch gates; eng to enumerate dependencies + rough cost delta; product to draft GA criteria doc and pilot plan. Sync Fri 09:00 PT.

Alex (arch): I'll drop RFC by Thu 17:00. Thanks all.
